text: these are really good, is it possible to extend it so they brush different? for example, here is a single dab from each one [Image #1]
resolution: Extended the map-paint brush gizmo selector from preview-only chrome into actual dab behavior. The five styles now paint differently: beam is a hard solid footprint, decal is a filled/feathered projected footprint, rings stamps center/inner/outer bands, profile preserves the selected falloff profile, and handles stamps center/axis/cardinal pads. The same style weights now drive terrain height, smooth, water coverage, and tile/flora/zone cell footprints, with profile as the default normal brush. Added Zig unit coverage for the new dab masks and preserved old profile sculpt behavior by default. Also made a minimal compatibility fix for the concurrent map store v2/material binding changes so validation could compile: engine save/load now passes tile bindings and store tests use the new undercoat/load signatures. Verified with zig build test-game-map and SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor.
